L3-1_decision_contradiction.detail: ADR-0024 is the only new ADR. It does not contradict any inherited ADR. ADR-0005 (append-only supersession) is explicitly honored by D-004 (extend Principle 3, do not restructure). ADR-0019 (naming convention) is conformed to by all 5 new KBs. ADR-0020 (KB structure) is conformed to by all 5 new KBs. No kill criteria of inherited ADRs are violated.

L3-2_open_item_handling.detail: Synthesis surfaced 6 decisions (D-001 through D-006); the Blueprint resolves all 6 with concrete primitive enumerations. 2 minor follow-ups from synthesis (CSF Factories adoption curve; Anthropic skill versioning) are surfaced as Future Extensibility / Risks with mitigation rather than silently dropped. 2 open items in cc-design.md ('Open items' subsection) are explicitly marked non-blocking and routed to future rounds.

L3-3_resurfaced_verified_issue.detail: No prior Architecture Audit for this feature (first audit cycle).

blast_radius_accuracy.detail: Codebase-analysis FA-004 establishes exactly 2 sub-agents preload KB-frontend-design (design-frontend.md, design-composer.md). Blueprint's FR-4 modification inventory matches: 2 agent files. Risk class estimates in codebase-analysis (low for frontmatter edits, low for new KBs, medium for content restructure) are consistent with Blueprint's risk table.

adr_wellformedness.detail: ADR-0024 has all 10 MADR sections (Status / Context / Decision / Decision Details / Rationale / Options Considered / Consequences / Architecture Impact / Implementation Guidance / Related Information). Kill criteria explicit. Options Considered carries Pros/Cons for all 3 enumerated options (A / B / B'). No 'ADR-for-the-sake-of-ADR' — the decision is substantive and load-bearing.

synthesis_claim_coverage.detail: Synthesis Findings F-001 through F-008 are all referenced or honored in the Blueprint: F-001 (Anthropic upstream) → D-002 + ADR-0024 Rationale; F-002 (KB-frontend-design prose-first) → preserved per D-004 + ADR-0005; F-003 (platform-KB pattern) → Primitive 5 follows it; F-004 (field-standard separation) → ADR-0024 Rationale; F-005 (a11y-baseline + a11y-flow complementary) → D-004; F-006 (Storybook version state) → D-003; F-007 (FR-4 blast-radius bounded) → Modifications 1+2; F-008 (pedagogical-marker precedent) → D-006.

frontmatter_correctness_for_new_skills.detail: Per cc-design.md Primitive 1-5: all 5 new KBs follow the convention codified in KB-cc-design/references/patterns-and-anti-patterns.md. None carry 'disable-model-invocation: true' (per FA-003 precedent; only action skills with side effects carry it). 'user-invocable' explicitly not set (defaults to invocable for /skill discoverability).

ac_traceability_to_blueprint.detail: Blueprint's AC section traces 11 EARS-format ACs to FR-1 through FR-8. Each FR has at least one AC. AC-FR-1-a through AC-FR-1-f map 1:1 to the six topical areas (the original FR-1 sub-AC structure). AC-FR-8-a is conditionally satisfied (the FR-8 P3 conditional pattern from intent-clarification).

issues.finding: Three artifacts state the chosen structural option (Option B) and the KB-count delta (17 → 22). If any future revision changes the choice (e.g., reverting to Option A or B'), all three must update atomically — Blueprint Update History, ADR-0024 version (or supersession), and cc-design.md.
issues.recommendation: At plan-authoring time, the supersession discipline (ADR-0005) provides the canonical mechanism: ADR-0024 is preserved; a new ADR-NNNN supersedes it. The Plan should NOT introduce its own version-tracking — rely on the ADR supersession chain.

issues.location: ADR-0024 Related Information; cc-design.md Open items #2
issues.finding: The corpus's anti-slop content is anchored on Anthropic's /mnt/skills/public/frontend-design/SKILL.md (Nov 12, 2025). If Anthropic supersedes or removes this skill, the citation chain breaks. The project has no contractual claim on the upstream artifact's availability.
issues.recommendation: The Risks section of the Blueprint already documents this (Row 2 of the Risks table). For ongoing operability, KB-visual-design/references/anti-slop.md should include a 'Source Dependencies' section that names the upstream skill version (Nov 12, 2025), and project KB content should be substantively complete even without the upstream cite (i.e., the cite enriches but does not solely carry the discipline). Plan should include an AC for this self-sufficiency check.

audit_notes: This is integration test #2's first Architecture Audit. No prior audit cycles.
The Blueprint's single-layer scope (cc only) simplifies the audit substantially — most multi-layer contradiction-detection checks are trivially satisfied.
Zero Q-CC-N items surfaced at per-layer Design means no cross-layer arbitration to verify at this stage.

ADR-0024's Kill criteria provide a clear future-revision path; an audit failure mode against this Blueprint would require either (a) discovery that the field-standard separation premise is wrong, or (b) measured context-cost degradation in practice. Neither is in evidence.
